note: Agricenter International's RV park in east Memphis: back-to-back gravel rows in open ground beside the farmers market and the ShowPlace Arena, with little shade. Sold by the night, week and month. No tents. --Claude
summary: Agricenter RV Park: operator page (with a 2024 Wayback match), Google and Esri read. $48 + tax ($45 seniors/military), weekly $290, monthly $625.20, unchanged since Oct 2024; full hookups 30/50 A, showers, laundry, dump; 3-month max stay. Under the $50 gate before tax. Google 4.1 (331). Kept; nightly share unmeasured.
flags: PRICE GATE: $48.00 + tax is under US$50 as posted; with Shelby County sales tax (~9.75%) and the 3% card surcharge it is ~$54 at the till. The operator's $45 senior/military rate is also posted. Kept as under the gate on the posted rate - flag if the gate is meant to include tax.

LONG-STAY TESTS: daily, weekly and monthly rates side by side; 'Maximum stay is three months' caps residency; 'for work or play'; reviews describe mostly overnight pass-through stays (RV Life: 'Friends stayed here three months'). No wording discourages nightly guests; no minimum stay; no tent sites ('No tents allowed'). Esri shows most rows full, so the nightly share cannot be measured from imagery - possibly a large monthly/work-crew share. Not a drop candidate on the evidence.
FAIRGROUND TEST: the park takes ordinary nights - a standing daily rate, no event-only wording; it also fills for arena events (rallies, horse shows).
SITE COUNT 300 is note-derived; the operator page gives no number. Not written.
PHONE 901-355-1977 confirmed (operator page + Google). The page names the park contact; not repeated in the note.
